## source: docs [R §2b] (configure terminal, write startup-config, set cli pagination off)
<<< sw10-lab-01#
>>> set cli pagination off
<<< sw10-lab-01#
>>> set cli prompt off
<<< sw10-lab-01#
>>> configure
% Incomplete Command
<<< sw10-lab-01#
>>> configure terminal
<<< sw10-lab-01(config)#
>>> interface gigabitethernet 0/2
<<< sw10-lab-01(config-if)#
>>> no shutdown
<<< sw10-lab-01(config-if)#
>>> end
<<< sw10-lab-01#
>>> write startup-config
Copy operation completed successfully
